title: Visitor and Harvest
author: Mara Almeida
blurb: Juniper Vasquez, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
